# game-mount

> Renderer-neutral rendering policy and parent-sized mounts for Pixi, React Three Fiber and Babylon.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://jonbogaty.com/game-mount/introduction/): scope and entry points.
- [Getting started](https://jonbogaty.com/game-mount/getting-started/): installation and mounting examples.
- [API](https://jonbogaty.com/game-mount/API/): exported functions, components and lifecycle contracts.
- [Architecture](https://jonbogaty.com/game-mount/ARCHITECTURE/): dependency boundaries and invariants.
- [Decisions](https://jonbogaty.com/game-mount/decisions/): design rationale.
- [Contributing](https://jonbogaty.com/game-mount/contributing/): development and validation.
- [Release history](https://jonbogaty.com/game-mount/release-history/): release status.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/jbcom/game-mount): source, tests and issues.
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/game-mount): package registry entry after first release.

Use only the adapter subpath needed by the application. The core needs no peers. All renderer peers are optional; install the selected adapter's peers explicitly. Mounts require a browser and a parent with a resolved height.
